title: Javier Ortiz Portfolio — Light Editorial System

motion.name: editorial-entry
motion.purpose: Optional route-level reveal; content remains complete without it.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove motion while preserving content and focus.

components.name: Editorial Header
components.description: Square links and a one-pixel rule with visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Case Study Frame
components.description: Prelude, split thesis, evidence rail, chapter index and rule-separated chapters.

components.name: Evidence Media
components.description: Contained provisional screenshots on a dark neutral surface; no destructive crop.

components.name: Fact List
components.description: Compact role, scope and collaboration facts aligned beside hero evidence.

components.name: Caption
components.description: Short provenance-aware caption that distinguishes provisional material from outcomes.

narrative.overview: A light Swiss-editorial system where spacing, typography and evidence boundaries carry the identity. Case studies use real provisional screenshots without pretending they are final mockups or measured outcomes.

rules.name: Evidence stays legible
rules.body: Screenshots and mockups are contained rather than cropped; captions state their provisional status.

rules.name: Air before ornament
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from measure and spacing, not card chrome, decorative gradients or generic shadows.

rules.name: Claims stay scoped
rules.body: Qualitative descriptions are separated from verified metrics and fictitious outcomes.

dos: Use one visual system across Home, About and case studies.
Preserve noindex and link-only access for preview.
Keep real evidence and provenance visible.
donts: Do not crop product screenshots until interface text becomes illegible.
Do not add permanent dark surfaces to the light editorial page shell.
Do not turn provisional captures into claims of impact.
